summary.name: Meta AI
summary.one_liner: Meta AI is a conversational personal assistant from Meta that generates and edits images, suggests shopping and local places, and writes cited research reports.
use_cases: generate images from a text description
edit or restyle photos by asking or sketching
shop and compare products within a budget
find highly rated nearby restaurants or cafes
research a topic into a report with pros and cons
draft Instagram captions and content plans
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Meta AI as a chat-based assistant where users describe what they want in conversation. It can generate images from text prompts, such as logos, thumbnails, or cards, and edit photos by changing backgrounds, removing backgrounds, touching up, restyling, or sketching directly on an image. It can help narrow and compare products against a stated budget, and recommend nearby places based on location and preferences. It can search across sources and turn findings into a cited research report with timelines and pros and cons, and it offers help drafting captions, bios, and content plans for Instagram.
notable: Image generation and photo editing through conversation, including sketching on photos
Research mode that produces a cited report with timelines and pros and cons
Integrated across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and web
Built on Meta's Llama models, per a directory listing
caveats: The page does not state pricing tiers; the 'free' label comes from its meta description offering free image creation and a directory tag.
